title: Kenneth Walker wins Super Bowl MVP, first RB in 28 years

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kenneth Walker wins Super Bowl MVP, first RB in 28 years
sources.description: There wasn’t a lot of offense in Super Bowl 60, but Seahawks’ running back Kenneth Walker was the best by a mile. Using a combination of speed, poise, and vision, Walker finished with 27 carries for 135 yards and another 26 yards receiving. Yards through the air were few and far between in the biggest […]
